authority.warning: This document distinguishes confirmed rules from design proposals and open questions; it is not immutable nor a verified implementation.

principle: Builder is an optional AIGMos System View |BUILD with Panels, System commands and functions on the same HC.CS/module registry. It composes a new instance using source modules available to its Builder instance, without introducing a new Hardcore mechanism. Selected feature graph and dependency closure determine actual physical source inclusion.

confirmed.rule: One functional MP-compatible shared source implementation; CP adds only selected capabilities.
Each code file, including Hardcore, begins with exact header keys deps, libs, target. deps/libs are JSON arrays of immediate uses only; target is MP or CP. MP means MicroPython and CPython.
Builder composes from its available modules and may include Builder in target only if selected and target-compatible.
Build physically removes unselected code, optional integrations, exclusive dependencies, and unneeded transport listeners. NON-AC build has neither AC implementation nor AC-specific CS hook.
Structured # is optional; standard minimal MP build does not include #. Q absent => no Q code/config/validator or exclusive dependencies. Q selected => valid q.default required at boot.
Target source composition built before target configuration. C6-oriented MP composition can run on PC with explicit hardware shims; this is not a C6 firmware emulator.
Target provisioning may configure persistent TER definitions via explicit FILE; no automatic MEM persistence.
Protected /config is never ordinarily read/written by CS. BOOT/internal RELOAD may read. AC activation false->true is sole runtime CS-triggered write exception.
Build output must prove code references beyond Python import graph, including persisted TER command strings and module/adapter/Expose capability references.

proposed_pipeline.name: Inventory
proposed_pipeline.operation: Scan all candidate source files once, parse exact 3-line headers, source hashes, module identities/roles, declared capabilities and ownership. Source inventory limited to files physically available to Builder.

proposed_pipeline.name: Select
proposed_pipeline.operation: Choose target MP/CP, requested module/capability IDs, transport/profile, hardware adapters, required target provisioning materials. Distinguish build selection from runtime /config.

proposed_pipeline.name: Resolve
proposed_pipeline.operation: Compute typed direct dependency graph from header SSOT and separately derived transitive closure. Validate graph classes, platform eligibility, cycles, availability, source classification and hard constraints.

proposed_pipeline.name: Trim
proposed_pipeline.operation: Include five HC mechanisms and selected/required file+function capabilities; remove unused files, optional hooks and exclusive imports/libs. Use an explicit build annotation contract for code within files, not ad-hoc string replacement.

proposed_pipeline.name: Validate
proposed_pipeline.operation: Re-scan generated code, compare imports to declared deps/libs, verify all reachable commands from definitions/boot, panel and transport refs, ensure no optional feature leak, check path security and resource estimates. Fail closed on unknown/dynamic unresolved references.

proposed_pipeline.name: Package
proposed_pipeline.operation: Emit runnable target source tree, only relevant module assets, provisioning defaults separate from runtime state, and provenance/validation report. Do not claim canonical LOCKED just because packaging succeeds.

proposed_pipeline.name: Simulate
proposed_pipeline.operation: Start target-profile code on PC with explicitly chosen hardware host adapters, test boot, commands, scoped persistence, resource budgets and negative cases.

proposed_pipeline.name: Provision
proposed_pipeline.operation: Configure new target instance with safe out-of-band /config provisioning and explicit FILE-backed definitions. A temporary Expose is optional for permitted CS-mediated runtime/TER setup; it is not an exemption for ordinary /config writes.

proposed_pipeline.name: Strip and revalidate
proposed_pipeline.operation: Optionally physically remove temporary Expose interfaces and exclusive closure; rerun full closure and command-reference tests, including post-strip boot.

proposed_pipeline.name: Deploy
proposed_pipeline.operation: Copy validated output to target hardware, prove basic execution and resource behavior there.

source_metadata.declared_edges: Exact, immediate typed references only (source headers SSOT)
source_metadata.derived_edges: Calculated from scanned graph with full provenance; never written back as falsely declared direct deps
source_metadata.source_capability_mapping: OPEN: module registry/meta/feature declarations must not become a conflicting manually-maintained requires graph
source_metadata.intra_file_conditional_pruning: OPEN: need a safe explicit syntax + verifier to eliminate AC guard without parallel HC.CS implementations

build_invariants: MP transitively reaches CP-only source => FAIL
Forbidden dependency class or cycle => FAIL
Missing referenced CS command in TER/boot/config/layout => FAIL
NON-AC build contains any AC code or AC-specific hook => FAIL
Q-free build contains Q-only source, Q-only validation requirement or Q config secrets => FAIL
Q-enabled target with absent/malformed q.default => FAIL at boot
REST dollar-only build includes structured-only code with no other requested reason => FAIL
EXPOSE stripped but listener still bundled or reachable => FAIL
Any ordinary CS/extension filesystem path reaches protected /config via traversal/symlink => FAIL
Every included source file retains valid three-line metadata and exact source provenance
Unresolved dynamic module import / command string / capability reference must be declared or rejected

open_decisions.question: Exact build-selectable feature/capability ID vocabulary, registry and per-file mapping; source header remains only authority for direct deps.
Source-level conditional annotation grammar to remove AC-specific code inside single HC.CS implementation; how optional direct deps are declared without contradictory unconditional source headers.
Module interface/manifest and lifecycle ABI: how selected command, input, output, adapter and panel modules are discovered and initialized.
Target artifact tree format for MP/CP and exact code/assets split; whether to generate manifests/provenance as deployable or build-only files.
Provision /config of NEW target without weakening protection of RUNNING builder/target; exact config schema and AC activation physical path.
Host shim contract and ESP32-C6 resources/import subset; what is statically testable vs requires device test.
|BUILD Panels/CS operations, save/load selection profiles and report surface; these are UI/composition, not separate core engine.
Deterministic build snapshot/provenance and supported third-party lib resolution; no implicit network install.
How to handle dynamic import, reflection, plugin discovery, template references and generated data in closure checks.
Resource ceilings and exact validation gates for MP on C6-N16 without PSRAM.

first_design_decision_recommendation.topic: conditional pruning inside one source file
first_design_decision_recommendation.suggested_direction: A declarative opt-in feature fence with syntax-aware validation, permitted only at well-defined Python statement boundaries. Keep the three mandatory header lines; add an explicit rule for optional imports/dependencies. Build from immutable source snapshot and reject malformed or unsafe regions. No free-form code editing by Builder.
first_design_decision_recommendation.why: NON-AC output must contain no AC hook code while CS has only one common source implementation; whole-file selection cannot achieve this by itself.

milestones.can_start_coding_when: Per-component CCF/CW contracts and minimal HC interfaces are sufficiently defined and validated; do not require whole 1.9 release to be LOCKED before beginning component implementation.
milestones.build_tool_implementation_after: Hardcore, needed Core/System module registration and dependency header scanner foundations are available; follows A19-003 order.
milestones.builder_lock_when: Complete Build Tool contract passes canonical CCF 2.4.2, NodeTypes 1.15.1, Rules 3.11.0 and structural/behavioral test gates.
